advice-a981fcbe698a094088afcbd5.title: Calibration through Effort
advice-a981fcbe698a094088afcbd5.body: Physical training in the system of Aretology is a controlled entry into the zone of pain. We approach the limit not for the sake of “records”, but to find the point where the will begins to “melt”. Pain is the fire that burns loose impurities out of the “statue” of your personality. A conscious person regards the burning sensation in the muscles as a liturgical process of condensing pneuma. Where an ordinary person sees a reason to stop, you see a moment to strengthen the eidos. You need to learn to balance pain and reason.

advice-4fa1bff2f6285af9eea7d97c.title: Controlling Automatic Eating
advice-4fa1bff2f6285af9eea7d97c.body: Remember Pythagoras’s precept: “Labours are good, and pleasures are evil in every respect”. Every deliberate refusal of food during a fast is an exercise in Menos. You demonstrate to your flesh that it is merely a tool in the hands of a master. Someone who can voluntarily go without food for three days will fear neither market fluctuations nor external pressure. You become an autonomous pole of strength whose Centre does not depend on a full stomach. Practise this only if you have no health contraindications.

advice-f76bd6cde85231279d4498c7.title: The Practice of “Intelligent Hunger”
advice-f76bd6cde85231279d4498c7.body: A conscious person never eats until the stomach is overfull. That is harmful. Fullness of the stomach is a breach in your defences. You must maintain a slight, controlled deficit that keeps your “inner string” taut. As Pythagoras taught, “labours are good, and pleasures are evil”, so eating should be as functional as possible. Any “sensual indulgence” at the table is a voluntary surrender of power over your “ruling principle” to the lower forces of matter.

advice-ee04ba56f658caa669792477.title: The Practice of “Pure Water”
advice-ee04ba56f658caa669792477.body: At certain times, preferably around the new moon and full moon, practise complete abstinence from solid food, taking only pure water. In the system of Aretology, water acts as a solvent of miasmas. According to Pythagoras, “health is a particular order”, and the absence of the burden of digestion allows this order to re-establish itself naturally. For this time, your body should become “transparent”, like crystal. Stop the practice if you experience weakness, dizziness or any deterioration in how you feel. Practise only if you have no health contraindications.

advice-b26231fd11e1c6c1172f8440.title: The Practice of the “Pure Crystal”
advice-b26231fd11e1c6c1172f8440.body: Practise a three-day water fast as a ritual of hermetically sealing the vessel. According to Pythagoras, “health is a particular order”, and this order is restored only in the silence of an empty stomach. When you abstain from food, you remove the “earthly impurity” that, in Plotinus’s words, makes the soul “shed its plumage and fall”. Your body should become so “dry” (free of swelling) and light that, as the magical papyri put it, you feel as though you are “crossing space upwards”. Fasting is not a universal means of restoring health. Practise it correctly and consciously.

advice-268fe6cae8a210cb0b181b1e.title: Incubation of Intellectual Menos
advice-268fe6cae8a210cb0b181b1e.body: The new moon and full moon are good times to lighten the burden on the body. Remember that hunger is not a deficit, but an “intelligent heat”. Use the state of fasting to solve the most complex strategic problems. In the absence of a biological burden, your Reason gains an enormous resource that must be used. As Heraclitus taught, “the dry soul is the wisest”. Fasting burns away the viscosity of thought and makes your perception as sharp as a ray of the Sun that “will not slip, will not fall”. Practise fasting carefully, provided you have no health contraindications.

advice-5d1fe6aac20fbcc3b88c4dec.title: The Practice of Pneumatic Nourishment
advice-5d1fe6aac20fbcc3b88c4dec.body: During fasting at the new moon and full moon, complement abstinence from food with the practice of “breathing in light”. Use the Hermetic technique: “Draw in the rays of spirit, inhaling three times with all your strength”. Focus on how pneuma fills your tissues, strengthening the “walls of the vessel” without the involvement of gross matter. Someone who has learned to nourish their tone through will gains autonomy from market cycles and biological need. This practice does not replace nourishment; it temporarily calms the mind. You should not abstain from water. Practise consciously and attentively, only if you have no health contraindications.

advice-b6724e2aa3869613950ca22f.title: Controlling Biological Self-Pity
advice-b6724e2aa3869613950ca22f.body: Fasting at the new moon and full moon is a time of practice for the strong in spirit. Scorn the weakness of your “sensitive corpse” demanding food. Marcus Aurelius advised “disregarding the flesh”, seeing it as merely “a tangle of veins and ducts”. Fasting is a form of “intelligent frenzy” in which you demonstrate that Logos, rather than instinct, rules your microcosm. Only by passing through the “emptiness” of fasting does a conscious person gain the right to the “fullness” of power over reality. Practise consciously, provided you have no health contraindications and feel well.
